name: Broken Link Report 2026-05-29
body:
> Report · 2026-05-29

# Summary
Automated broken-link crawl of three client sites run 2026-05-29 01:49 (155 seconds) by `broken_link_check.py`, with the same data in `broken_link_report.json`. For each site it lists pages crawled, outbound links checked and every broken link with the pages it was found on. The companion [Dead Link Locations 2026-05-29](lib:brain-dead-link-locations-2026-05-29) report pinpoints where each dead link sits on the page.

# Results by site
| Site | Pages crawled | Outbound links checked | Broken pages | Broken links |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| summitplumbingpros.com | 145 | 167 | 0 | 7 |
| alphaletetrenchless.com | 243 | 350 | 0 | 8 |
| pipelinersusa.com | 111 (110 OK) | 331 | 1 | 85 |

Across all sites the broken entries break down as about 38 x 404, 45 x 520 (Twitter share intents), 10 x 403, 6 connection errors and 2 timeouts.

# Key findings
- **Summit:** a malformed href `http://Summit Plumbing` on /old-cracked-and-corroded-pipes/; phone numbers coded as `http://(480) 447-7008` links on the pipe-lining city pages (9 pages); 5 dead Water Softener city links (Mesa, Phoenix, Queen Creek, Scottsdale, Tempe) from /water-softeners/ because those pages did not exist yet.
- **Alphalete:** 404s from homepage and /services/ to old slugs (/services/residential-pipelining, /pipelining, /inspection); missing drain-cleaning pages for Florence and Manitou Springs; phone coded as `http://480-680-9480` on /free-video-inspection/; Twitter share 520s.
- **Pipeliners:** /is-pipelining-worth-it/ itself was a 404 and linked from several posts; the homepage linked to many dead archive and category URLs (/pipe-repair/page/N/, /pipeliners/page/N/, /root-intrusion/, /plumbing-tips/, /service-areas/, /reviews/, /epoxy/ and old post slugs); /reviews/ also linked from city pages; most 520s are Twitter share intents on every blog post; 403s are external sources (a competitor page, kjzz.org, Unsplash credits) that may just block bots; privacy policy links to freeprivacypolicy.com timed out.

# Notes
- Twitter intent 520s and bot-blocked 403s are mostly false positives, not real breakage.
- The wrong phone href formats are the same issue later called out in [Optimization Report 2026-05-30](lib:brain-optimization-report-2026-05-30) ("pipe-lining phone-href").
